# synthetic: quoted literals escaped, constant, or from a fixed set
KINDS = ("a", "b")


def fine(con, name):
    esc = name.replace("'", "''")
    con.execute(f"SELECT id FROM item WHERE name = '{esc}'")
    con.execute(f"SELECT id FROM item WHERE kind IN ({', '.join(repr(k) for k in KINDS)})")
    con.execute("SELECT id FROM item WHERE name = ?", (name,))
